title: C_GenerateKey: argument validation and AES/DES key gen
description: C_GenerateKey returns CKR_FUNCTION_NOT_SUPPORTED without checking arguments. Need: (1) proper argument validation (session, mechanism, template, output pointer) to fix GenerateKeyInvalid; (2) AES/DES/3DES key generation with CKA_SENSITIVE, CKA_EXTRACTABLE, CKA_VALUE_LEN attribute support to fix TookanAttack A1/A3/A4/A5a/A5b, FindObjectSubset, SetLatchingAttribute, WrapUnwrap.
